name: Bernice Bakery (cookies and cakes, Montreal)
awwwardsEvidence: WebSearch result title 'Bernice Bakery - Awwwards Honorable Mention' (awwwards.com/sites/bernice-bakery), summary: '(Casa Media): a Shopify template for a Montreal bakery, dated Feb 28, 2025'. The live footer ends with 'Made by Casa Media', which matches the credited studio. Award page itself not loaded (awwwards.com unreachable from this environment).

observed.layout: Shopify storefront, ≈7 800 px desktop / ≈10 100 px mobile. Full-bleed overhead photo of sliced cakes with 'A BAKING LOVE AFFAIR' in white caps bottom-left and a pink round 'INDULGE' badge → manifesto line in teal caps + small cake sticker → 'BESTSELLERS' outline marquee behind product cards in arch frames → 'THE BEST THINGS IN LIFE ARE SWEET' centred → row of round/arched photos → cookie/cake tabs with product grid (qty stepper + pink 'ADD TO CART') → press quote cards (teal/black rounded panels with publication logos) → 'CELEBRATE WITH CAKE' circular text + round pink 'ORDER' button → newsletter panel → teal footer with address, email, tel and a full-width 'BERNICE' wordmark.
observed.typography: Computed: headings 'Apfel Grotezk' 700 uppercase (h1 172.8 px / line-height 0.6 on desktop, 66.3 px on mobile; h3 product names 24 px), body 'balto' 400 at 17.6/22 px (15.4 px mobile). Two families only.
observed.imagery: Overhead food photography with crumbs and frosting, product shots of single cookies on grey, a few people/interior photos cropped into circles and arches. 87 of 105 without usable alt.
observed.motion: GSAP and a Lenis-style smooth scroll detected; outline marquee words drift sideways; the INDULGE badge rotates. With prefers-reduced-motion emulated, 9 Web Animations were still running and transforms still changed (no reduced-motion handling observed).
observed.responsive: Mobile keeps the order; nav collapses to bag/search/menu icons; product cards become a single column with full-width pink buttons; a pickup-date panel (day/time) is part of the cart drawer. tel: link present in the footer only.

whyItWorks: Appetite plus a loud, friendly voice: one chunky grotesk in caps, one candy accent (pink) and round shapes (badge, arches, circle buttons) make a small bakery feel like a brand without any fake claims; pickup rules (days, hours, 48 h hold) are written plainly where you order.
principles: Pick one round, edible shape (circle badge, arch) and repeat it for buttons, photo crops and stickers.
One chunky display family in caps for names and prices, a soft text face for the rest.
Put the ordering rules (pickup days, hours, lead time) right next to the order action, in plain sentences.
End on a full-width wordmark footer with address, phone and email.
doNotCarryOver: Press logos and 'best' quotes unless the owner provides them (rule 8).
Images without alt; ignoring reduced motion; phone only in the footer.
Their pink/teal palette, wordmark, stickers and product photos.

name: Sonoma Bakery (artisan sourdough, Sydney)
awwwardsEvidence: WebSearch result title 'Sonoma Bakery - Awwwards Honorable Mention' (awwwards.com/sites/sonoma-bakery), summary: '(NIGHTJAR) … dated Jun 6, 2022'. The live HTML source carries the comment '* Site by https://nightjar.co', matching the credited studio. Award page not loaded. The live site may have changed since 2022.

observed.layout: Desktop document height equals the viewport (900 px): the page scrolls inside a transformed custom scroller, the wheel moves it. Full-bleed macro of a scored, floured sourdough crust filling the first screen with one short white sentence ('Pure intentions, humble beginnings, quality focus & exceptional customer service. Available in store today.') → product strip (loaf photos with name and price) → founder quote on a tan block ('It takes 36 hours and a lifetime of experience…' — Andrew Connole, Founder) → process photos (dough, hands) → origin story → mailing list → link grid footer (Connect / Get in touch / Shop / Sonoma) → 'UP NEXT — Shop' full-width photo panel that leads to the next page.
observed.typography: Computed: one grotesk 'BrutGrotesqueBook' 400 everywhere (h1 64/70.4 px, statement 28.8 px with −0.02em, h2 32–52 px, body 16/22.4 px; mobile h1 42 px). Prices and product labels in 'Typewriter_Condensed' 14 px uppercase with 0.15em tracking ('SONOMA MICHE  19.50  BREAD').
observed.imagery: Dark, low-key macro photography of crust, flour and dough, hands working; warm brown/black with flour-white highlights. All 12 images had alt text.
observed.motion: Very little: page-level smooth scroll, no Web Animations at idle, no change observed between normal and reduced-motion emulation (nothing to reduce).
observed.responsive: Mobile uses normal document scroll (≈3 900 px), stacks the same blocks, sticky header with 'PICKUP' link and menu; tel: links present (header menu and footer).

whyItWorks: Appetite first and nothing else: one crust filling the screen does the selling, and the copy is a single plain sentence. A typewriter face for name + price makes the menu read like a bakery ticket instead of an e-commerce grid.
principles: Let one macro photo of the product's texture (crust, flour) own the first screen; keep the words to one sentence.
Set prices and product labels in a small tabular/typewriter voice, like a bakery ticket.
Quote the owner on how long the process takes (a real number) instead of adjectives.
End each page with an 'Up next' panel so there is no dead end.
doNotCarryOver: Custom transformed scroller on desktop (scroll position not in the document; anchors and find-in-page suffer).
Opening-hours and address buried in other pages.

name: Enoteca della Valpolicella (wine bar and kitchen, Fumane)
awwwardsEvidence: Only a WebSearch summary of an Awwwards listing page: 'Enoteca della Valpollicella (ET Studio), a wine bar site, is listed with an Honorable Mention on Jul 25, 2025' (the summary itself warned that dates in the listing run together). No /sites/ page found and no studio credit on the live site, so the live site ↔ award match is by name only.

observed.layout: Cream paper page (rgb 249,243,227), ≈8 600 px desktop. Fixed top rule with 'INDICE' left, HOME / MENU / MANIFESTO / VINI / PERSONE centre, 'PRENOTA' right. Opening: 'L'ENOTECA' set huge and centred with small notes in the corners ('BENVENUT*', 'DIAMO A CASA', 'N°001'). Chapters numbered with big Roman numerals (I, II, III, IV) each with 'N°00x' and a word set huge ('BELIEVES', 'IN PEOPLE', 'AND TERRA'); typewriter paragraphs in two columns; photos tilted a few degrees like prints laid on a table; menu chapter shows a white card ('MENU') with a black-and-white photo.
observed.typography: Computed: display 'SelfModern' 400 uppercase (h2 100.8/90.7 px desktop, 50 px mobile), all body and nav in 'CourierNew' 16/32 px (14/28 mobile), plus a handwritten face ('September') in blue ink for small marginal notes ('#tag – il posto che…'). No h1 on the page.
observed.imagery: Warm documentary photos: the owners laughing together, plates, vineyard, a chef's hands; printed-photo look (tilted, white margin on some).
observed.motion: Lenis smooth scroll (transform-based; window.scrollY stayed 0). Transforms were still changing under reduced-motion emulation (not honoured).
observed.responsive: Mobile keeps INDICE + PRENOTA in the top bar, single column, typewriter body at 14 px; a third-party cookie panel covered ≈40 % of every mobile screenshot and ≈25 % on desktop until accepted. No tel: link found.

whyItWorks: It reads like a kitchen notebook: typewriter text, blue handwritten margin notes and tilted prints make the place feel hand-run, and the numbered index keeps a long story navigable.
principles: A handwritten note in one ink colour can carry warmth for small facts (times, tips) without decoration elsewhere.
Number the chapters and keep an index plus the main action (book/order) fixed in the top bar.
Lay photos like prints: slight tilt, paper margin; never more than one per view.
doNotCarryOver: Body copy in Courier for long paragraphs (tiring); no h1; no tel: link.
Cookie panel covering the content; smooth-scroll that ignores reduced motion.
